name: skills-lab
description: A browsable atlas and live WebGPU exhibit hall for the game-development techniques this workspace has studied, adapted or rejected.

scripts.qa:publish: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const src='qa/captures/report.json';const out='public/assets/skills-lab/captures';if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.log('qa:publish: no capture run to publish — site builds without evidence.');process.exit(0);}fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,out+'/report.json');let n=1;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('qa/captures')){if(f.endsWith('.png')){fs.copyFileSync('qa/captures/'+f,out+'/'+f);n++;}}console.log('qa:publish: published '+n+' files to '+out+'/');"
